NovaStore, the full-stack flagship.

A React storefront on a Django REST API, with admin panel and live CMS. Open on GitHub.

Open sourceGitHub

NovaStore source on GitHub
Flagship build

NovaStore

A full-stack e-commerce platform for shoppers who pay cash and owners who want control. Catalog and search, wishlists, a slide-out cart, multi-step Cash on Delivery checkout with tracking and returns, plus a customer dashboard and an admin panel with a live CMS - React and Vite up front, Django REST and PostgreSQL behind, open on GitHub.

FAQs

Quick answers.
Still have one? Write below.

  • I design and build websites and e-commerce storefronts, mostly with React, TypeScript and Django. Recent work includes a live e-commerce site for a home furnishings brand and a full-stack store with its own admin panel.

  • I usually reply within one business day. Small fixes can start within a few days; larger builds like a store or company site are scheduled one to two weeks out. I work Nepal time (GMT+5:45) and overlap with Asia and European mornings.

  • Fixed quotes per project, scoped from a short call or a written brief. A company site and a full e-commerce build are priced very differently, so tell me what you need and you will get a clear quote with what is included.

  • Hetauda, Nepal. I work remotely with clients anywhere and I am happy to relocate for the right role. English and Nepali both work.

  • Your message lands directly in my inbox. You will hear back within one business day with next steps, usually a few questions and a time for a short call.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026

Who this covers

This policy covers the portfolio of Rohan Bista, frontend developer in Hetauda, Nepal. It applies to this site only, not to client sites or third-party profiles linked from it.

What is collected

This site runs no analytics and sets no tracking cookies. The contact form collects only what you type - your name, email and message - and your theme and accessibility preferences are stored in your own browser, never sent anywhere.

How it is used

Form contents are used for one purpose: replying to your inquiry. Unless a form backend is configured, submitting opens your own mail client addressed to info@rohanbista.com.np, so the message travels through your email provider. Nothing is sold or shared.

How long it is kept

Emails received through the contact form are kept as ordinary correspondence. To ask for deletion of anything you sent, write to the address below and it will be removed.

Contact

Questions about this policy: info@rohanbista.com.np

Terms of Service

Last updated: September 2026

Using this site

You may browse, read and share links to this portfolio freely. Project screenshots and write-ups are shown to demonstrate work; client sites remain the property of their owners.

Work and payment

Freelance projects are scoped in writing with a fixed quote before work starts. Smaller fixes are billed on agreement; larger builds follow milestones with a preview link at each step. Launch and handover happen once the final balance is settled.

Ownership

On final payment, clients own the delivered site and its content. Open-source builds credited on this site stay under their public licenses. Everything else on this site - text, layout and design - belongs to Rohan Bista unless stated otherwise.

Liability

This site is provided as-is. Project timelines and quotes given here are indicative until confirmed in a written agreement for your specific project.

Contact

Questions about these terms: info@rohanbista.com.np
